auditor_value: a₂ = −7a₁ (block 2's acceleration is 7 times block 1's, in the opposite direction; from x₁+x₃=c, (x₁−x₃)+(x₄−x₃)=c, (x₁−x₄)+(x₂−x₄)=c)

findings.quote: Writing only the top string's constraint (x₁ + x₃ = constant) and stopping there, which gives |a₂| = |a₁|
findings.note: The stated cause does not by itself produce the stated result: x₁ + x₃ = constant gives a₃ = −a₁ (pulley P₂, not block 2). Reaching |a₂| = |a₁| needs the extra assumption that block 2 moves with pulley P₂, which the entry does not say.
findings.fix: Writing only the top string's constraint (x₁ + x₃ = constant) and treating everything hanging below P₁ as one body that moves with pulley P₂, which gives |a₂| = |a₁|; each movable pulley below adds its own constraint, and combining all three gives a₂ = −7a₁.

notes: All three constraint equations and both substitutions check line by line; final answer agrees with mine.
